items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Dick Bock was on campus then, Dick Bock

ctx.x: Yeah and then they had a jazz, like a rehearsal group over there. Not organized. You know. And the orchestra was the first thing as the car made a turn on Monroe. That was the orchestra room, right there on the corner and I ran into Don Bagley there and later played with Stan Kenton.
Dick Bock was on campus then, Dick Bock
who started what -- Discovery Records a -- with Albert Marsh. Discovery Records and Pacific Jazz. He wrote the Jazz Column in the Collegian.
